articles.title: AI-Powered GTA 6 PC Ports Now Have Multiplayer as Modders Unlock 30 and 60 FPS
articles.snippet: Modders have added multiplayer to an unofficial PC port and unlocked higher frame rates on jailbroken consoles.

articles.title: Vibecoded GTA 6 PC Ports Are Now Rendering In-Game Graphics Despite Take-Two Crackdown
articles.snippet: Some unofficial ports now hit around 20 frames per second, as developers move their work into private communities to dodge takedowns.
